subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should Discord keep this channel-level retry and replay safeguard alongside the shared reply-session self-healing proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920?
rationale: Both changes address the same conflict at different ownership layers; source evidence supports layered protection, but maintainers must confirm the permanent boundary to avoid duplicated recovery policy or unintended retry interactions.

options.title: Keep layered recovery
options.body: Land the Discord retry after confirming it handles transient delivery loss while the shared layer handles persistent session wedges without duplicating durable side effects.

options.title: Wait for shared recovery
options.body: Pause this PR, land the shared lifecycle fix first, and reproduce the Discord loss again before deciding whether a channel-level safeguard remains necessary.

recommendation.title: Keep layered recovery
recommendation.body: Land the Discord retry after confirming it handles transient delivery loss while the shared layer handles persistent session wedges without duplicating durable side effects.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee and the clearest available owner for choosing the recovery boundary between the Discord plugin and shared session lifecycle.
